LCP.reason: the LCP element is the hero video's poster (110 kB AVIF) on a media-heavy page. Cropping it to the video ratio and moving it off JPEG took it from 180 kB to 110 kB and LCP from 2964 ms to 2644 ms; a high-priority preload measured as a no-op because the page is bandwidth-bound rather than discovery-bound. Affects both stacks equally. See docs/media.md.
